name: revival-herb
effect: Used on a party Pokémon : Revives a fainted Pokémon and restores its HP to full. Decreases happiness by 10/10/15.
short_effect: Revives with full HP, but lowers happiness.

flavor_text.black-white: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, fully restoring its HP.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: A very bitter medicinal herb. It revives a fainted Pokémon, fully restoring its HP.
